changes: transition-orchestrator.ts: added a post-lock, pre-merge mainSha re-check to the DONE transition. A readMainSha helper (git rev-parse --verify main^{commit}) captures syncedMainSha right after autoSyncMain and re-reads it right before store.writeStory persists phase=DONE; on a confirmed external main advance it throws a resync error so the existing try/finally releases the main-write-lock and the story stays at TEST (no partial DONE). Fail-open on an unreadable sha. The lock and applyDoneMergeEffects are unchanged. + a 14-check smoke and npm wiring.
usage: No new command; behavior is automatic on `lattice story_advance --phase=DONE`. Verify via: node packages/main/dist/tasks/done-premerge-mainsha-recheck-smoke.js (14 checks).
expectedOutcome: On an external main advance between the DONE pre-check sync and the in-lock merge, story_advance DONE fails with "DONE aborted: main advanced (<old7> -> <new7>) after the pre-check sync; nothing was merged and the story stays at TEST. Re-run story_advance DONE to resync." and the story phase stays TEST. With main unchanged in-lock, DONE merges normally.
actualTranscript: node packages/main/dist/tasks/done-premerge-mainsha-recheck-smoke.js -> "done-premerge-mainsha-recheck-smoke passed (14 checks)", exit 0 (abort path: resync error, phase stays TEST in both stores, no story-branch merge landed; happy path: DONE merges, worktree/branch cleaned). npm test -> ALL PASS with test:done-premerge-mainsha-recheck in the chain. RED/GREEN verified: disabling the re-check makes the abort assertion fail.
outcomeDiff: none — expected and actual match (14/14 smoke checks, full suite green, 8/8 intents covered).
limitations: The fix closes the EXTERNAL-advance window only (the main-write-lock already serializes concurrent Lattice DONEs). After-DONE auto-retry and a full merge-serialization rework were deliberately rejected. Fail-open on an unreadable main sha (a transient git read error does not block DONE). The lock-release on abort reuses the pre-existing try/finally (unchanged), evidenced by code structure rather than a same-root re-acquisition test (both review hosts judged this adequate).
pitfalls: The baseline sha MUST be captured AFTER autoSyncMain (else a normal DONE that synced would false-abort) and the re-check MUST be before store.writeStory persists phase=DONE (else a worse DONE-without-merge state). Use local main^{commit} (the merge target), not origin/main. The DONE merge auto-patch-bumps the version (B-aa8a) + auto-rebuilds dist, so do NOT bump/rebuild manually. Genuine Codex host-2 correctly flagged that the smoke uses separate temp roots for abort vs happy, so it does not itself prove same-lock re-acquisition — the evidence note was corrected to cite the unchanged shared finally instead.
